data.title: TORM plc announces pricing of secondary public offering of its class A common shares
data.description: In Hellerup, Denmark on September 15, 2026, maritime transportation company TORM plc disclosed the details of a secondary public offering. The offering involves 9,000,000 (nine million) Class A common shares of the company, and it is being facilitated by OCM Njord Holdings S.à r.l. This announcement comes from TORM, listed on NASDAQ under the ticker symbols TRMD and TRMD A.

data.title: Business Architecture Guild® Opens Call for Abstracts for 15th Annual Business Architecture Innovation Summit™
data.description: The Business Architecture Guild®, an international community of business architecture practitioners, has announced the opening of the call for presentation abstracts for the 15th Annual event in San Francisco on September 15, 2026. The organization is seeking real-world experiences and valuable lessons that contribute to the progression of the profession. This event aims to bring together industry experts to share insights and best practices. Interested individuals can submit their presentation ideas to be considered for inclusion in the conference program.

data.title: Sinch AB: Shoppers are cautious about AI, but confident when it has a job to do
data.description: A recent study by Sinch AB (publ) in Stockholm on shoppers' perceptions of AI before Black Friday and the upcoming holiday season revealed interesting insights. The research, based on a survey of 2,501 participants, highlighted a mixed sentiment among consumers. While there are general concerns about AI, respondents expressed strong confidence in its capabilities when applied to practical tasks. This nuanced perspective indicates a divergence in attitudes towards AI depending on its utility, signaling potential opportunities for businesses to leverage AI effectively in customer interactions.

data.title: Gretchen Rivera-Lebrón Brings Puerto Rican Design to the Global Stage in New International Book on Latin American Interiors
data.description: Rivera-Lebrón, the founder of Casa Casual, is the exclusive designer representing Puerto Rico in the book "Interior Design in Latin America." Two of Rivera-Lebrón's projects have been chosen, among the works of 28 studios from 20 countries. This remarkable achievement highlights Rivera-Lebrón's talent on an international platform. The book features a diverse range of interior design projects, showcasing the creativity and innovation in the field across Latin America. This recognition further solidifies Puerto Rico's presence in the global design community. The announcement was made in San Juan, Puerto Rico, on September 15, 2026.

data.title: Industry leaders scale full value chain for hydrogen mobility across Europe
data.description: In Gothenburg, Sweden on September 15, 2026, leading companies including Volvo Group, Daimler Truck, Toyota Motor Corporation, Bosch, Air Liquide, TotalEnergies, TEAL Mobility, and MB Energy announced a joint initiative at IAA Transportation to hasten the adoption of hydrogen-fueled vehicles in Europe. This collaborative effort aims to drive the deployment of hydrogen-powered vehicles at scale in the region.

data.title: Flex Announces New Company Name for the Planned Cloud and Power Infrastructure Spin-Off and Files Form 10 Registration Statement
data.description: Austin, TX - Flex (Nasdaq: FLEX) announced on September 15, 2026, the official name for its upcoming independent Cloud and Power Infrastructure company as Axiom Solutions International, Inc. This strategic move signifies Flex's focus on diversifying its business entities.

data.title: aiMotive Announces Professional Data Recording Hardware Lineup
data.description: In Budapest, Hungary, on September 15, 2026, aiMotive unveiled two new data recording tools - the aiMotive Rig and the aiMotive Rooftop Box. These systems aim to enhance ground truth data gathering for cutting-edge driver assistance technologies. The launch marks a significant milestone for the company as they continue to push the boundaries in the automotive industry.

data.title: Vera Therapeutics Announces TRUTAKNA™ (atacicept-vymj) Stabilized eGFR and Prevented Kidney Disease Progression Through Two Years in ORIGIN 3 Final Efficacy Analysis in IgA Nephropathy
data.description: Vera Therapeutics revealed that their drug TRUTAKNA™ (atacicept-vymj) successfully stabilized estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) and halted the progression of IgA nephropathy (IgAN) disease for up to 2 years, as per the latest ORIGIN 3 Final Analysis. This signifies a significant milestone in treatment, benefiting patients by preventing the worsening of kidney function.

data.title: Study: As Operating Costs Climb, Nearly Half of Canadian Restaurants Plan for More Menu Price Hikes, Trade-Offs on Critical Equipment Upgrades
data.description: In Vancouver, British Columbia, Canadian restaurants are experiencing increased cost pressures as per recent research by EconoLease, a major Canadian equipment financing provider for the hospitality sector. The study reveals that 80% of Canadian operators have raised menu prices in the last year, and 49% intend to do so again in the next year. The industry is facing significant financial challenges, prompting establishments to reconsider everything from menu pricing to investments in equipment.
